info.title: Talk2Tables API
info.description: AI-powered conversational SQL assistant for industrial databases. Built with FastAPI + LangGraph. UX4G compliant. Diploma Final Year Project — Mumbai, 2025-26.

post.summary: Login — verify Firebase ID token, return Service Account custom token
Register — client creates Firebase account, server upserts Firestore doc
post.description: Client calls createUserWithEmailAndPassword() in Firebase SDK, then sends the ID token here. Server upserts the Firestore user doc and returns a custom token. Functionally identical to /login.

post.summary: Check token + Firestore session validity (never raises 401)
Logout — revoke Firestore session + Firebase refresh tokens
Logout from all devices — revoke all Firestore sessions

get.summary: Current user profile from Firestore
List active Firestore sessions for current user

schema.title: Response Sessions Route Api V1 Auth Sessions Get

post.description: Register a new database connection. The password is encrypted with AES-256-GCM before storage. Requires db_manager or admin role.

get.summary: List all database connections
get.description: Returns all connections (active + inactive). Password is never included in any response. Requires db_manager or admin role.

get.summary: Get a single database connection

patch.description: Partial update — only provided fields are changed. If password is provided it is re-encrypted automatically.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the connection document. Consider using /deactivate instead to preserve audit history. Admin only.

post.description: Attempts to open a real connection to the target database. Updates last_tested_at and last_tested_ok on the connection document. Returns ok=true/false regardless — does NOT raise HTTP 4xx on DB failure. Requires db_manager or admin role.

get.summary: List query audit logs for a connection
get.description: Returns audit records for this connection (newest first). Optional filters: status (success|error), uid (filter by specific user). Requires db_manager or admin role.

get.summary: Usage statistics for a database connection
get.description: Aggregates audit logs to produce query counts, success rate, row totals, execution time averages, query type breakdown, top users, and daily activity. Use ?days=7|30|90|0 to control the lookback window (0 = all time). Requires db_manager or admin role.

post.summary: Force-invalidate the schema cache for a connection
post.description: Deletes all cached schema documents under this connection. The next query will re-fetch the schema from the live database and re-cache it. Use this after DDL changes (new tables, renamed columns, etc). Requires db_manager or admin role.

patch.summary: Disable a connection without deleting it
patch.description: Users with access to this DB will get 403 until it is re-activated.

post.description: Admin creates a user in Firebase Auth + Firestore. Role defaults to 'analyst'. User should change their password after first login.

get.summary: List all users
get.description: Returns all users. db_manager and admin can view.

get.summary: Get a single user

patch.description: Admin can update display_name and is_active.

delete.description: Permanently removes user from Firebase Auth AND Firestore. Consider deactivating instead to preserve audit history.

patch.description: Admin only. Updates role in Firestore AND sets Firebase custom claim so the new role is reflected in the next ID token refresh.
Disables the user in Firebase Auth and sets is_active=False in Firestore. User immediately loses access. Preferred over hard delete.

get.summary: List databases I have access to
get.description: Returns all active access grants for the current user, enriched with connection details (name, host, db_type, etc.). Password is never included. Available to any authenticated user.

post.summary: Grant a user access to a database
post.description: Creates a user_db_access document linking a user to a database. Raises 409 if an active grant already exists for this (user, db) pair. Requires db_manager or admin role.

get.summary: List access grants
get.description: Filter by ?uid=<firebase_uid> to get all DBs a user can access. Filter by ?connection_id=<id> to get all users on a DB. At least one filter is required.

get.summary: Get a single access grant

patch.summary: Update permission or expiry of a grant
patch.description: Change permission read ↔ write, expiry date, or note.

patch.summary: Revoke a user's access to a database
patch.description: Soft delete — sets is_active=False and records revoked_at. Document is kept for audit trail. User immediately loses query access.

post.description: Convert a natural language query to SQL, execute it against the specified database connection, and return structured results. Credentials are fetched from Firestore — never pass them in the request. Requires an active access grant for the connection.

get.summary: List tables for schema explorer
get.description: Returns all tables grouped by schema name. Uses Firestore schema cache (1h TTL). Safe for users who have never run a query — triggers a live DB fetch + cache write on first call. Requires an active access grant (or admin/db_manager role).

get.summary: Get column definitions for a specific table
get.description: Returns columns, data types, nullable, defaults, and FK relationships for the given table. Uses Firestore schema cache (1h TTL). Requires an active access grant (or admin/db_manager role).

get.summary: Get query history for the current user
get.description: Returns a paginated list of AI assistant messages across all chats and workspaces. Each item shows title, sql_query, timestamp, database, query_type, status, and favourited flag. Requires Firestore composite index on 'messages' collection group: firebase_uid ASC + role ASC + created_at DESC.

get.summary: Get audit logs for the current user
get.description: Returns raw audit records for queries run by the current user, across all connections. Each record contains sql_query, row_count, execution_time_ms, status, error_message, and timestamp. Optional filters: connection_id, status (success|error). Requires Firestore composite index on 'audits' collection group: firebase_uid ASC + created_at DESC.

get.summary: Get last 5 recent chats across all workspaces
get.description: Returns the 5 most recently updated chats for the current user, regardless of which DB they belong to. Requires a Firestore composite index on the 'chats' collection group: firebase_uid ASC + updated_at DESC.

get.summary: List all workspaces for the current user
get.description: Each workspace corresponds to one database connection the user has queried.

get.summary: List all chats in a workspace
Get all messages in a chat
get.description: Returns messages ordered by seq (ascending). Each message includes all stored fields.

get.summary: Get a single message with all fields
get.description: Returns the full message document including sql_query, data, numerical_insights, total_records, summary, and error_message. msg_id is the hex sequence ID: 0001, 0002, etc.

post.description: Mark an assistant message as favourited. Only assistant (a_XXXX) messages can be favourited.

delete.summary: Remove favourite from an AI message
delete.description: Unmark an assistant message as favourited.

AccessGrantOut.title: AccessGrantOut
AccessGrantOut.description: Full access grant record returned to frontend.

ConnectionOut.title: ConnectionOut
ConnectionOut.description:
Safe connection info returned to frontend.
password_enc is NEVER included — not even in admin responses.

firebase_uid.title: Firebase Uid
firebase_uid.description: Firebase UID of the user being granted access.

connection_id.title: Connection Id
connection_id.description: UUID of the database_connection to grant access to.

permission.title: Permission
permission.description: 'read' = SELECT only. 'write' = SELECT + INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE (power_user+ role still required at query time).

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 expiry. null = no expiry.

note.title: Note
note.description: Optional note e.g. 'Temp access for Q4 analysis'.

host.title: Host
host.description: Hostname or IP of the database server.

database_name.title: Database Name
database_name.description: The specific database/schema to connect to.

password.title: Password
password.description: Plaintext password — encrypted by backend before storage. Never logged.

ssl_enabled.title: Ssl Enabled
ssl_enabled.description: Whether to use SSL/TLS for the connection.

email.title: Email
email.description: Email address. Used as Firebase Auth login.

password.title: Password
password.description: Initial password. User should change after first login.

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: Full name shown in the UI.

role.title: Role
role.description: RBAC role. Defaults to analyst (least privilege).

CreateUserRequest.title: CreateUserRequest
CreateUserRequest.description: Body for POST /api/v1/users — admin creates a new user.

firebase_id_token.title: Firebase Id Token
firebase_id_token.description: Firebase ID token from client-side Firebase SDK after sign-in.

custom_token.title: Custom Token
custom_token.description: Firebase custom token signed by Service Account. Exchange via signInWithCustomToken() to get a fresh Firebase ID token.

LoginResponse.title: LoginResponse
LoginResponse.description:
custom_token — Firebase custom token signed by our Service Account.
Client MUST exchange it:
    await signInWithCustomToken(auth, custom_token)
The returned Firebase ID token will carry our role claim.

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: Session ID to revoke. Omit or null to revoke all sessions.

connection_id.title: Connection Id
connection_id.description: Firestore document ID from database_connections collection.

chat_input.title: Chat Input
chat_input.description: User's natural language query (English or Hindi).

chat_id.title: Chat Id
chat_id.description: Existing chat UUID to continue. Pass null/omit to start a new conversation.

example.chat_input: Show sensors overdue for calibration in the next 30 days

QueryResponse.title: QueryResponse
QueryResponse.description:
Unified response model for POST /api/v1/query.

data is a list so the frontend can do response.data[0].sql_query etc.
On success:  data = [{ sql_query, summary, total_records, numerical_insights, data }]
On error:    data = [{ error_message }]

UpdateAccessGrantRequest.title: UpdateAccessGrantRequest
UpdateAccessGrantRequest.description: Body for PATCH /api/v1/access-grants/{id} — change permission or expiry.

UpdateConnectionRequest.title: UpdateConnectionRequest
UpdateConnectionRequest.description: Body for PATCH /api/v1/connections/{id} — all fields optional.

role.title: Role
role.description: New role to assign to the user.

UpdateUserRequest.title: UpdateUserRequest
UpdateUserRequest.description: Body for PATCH /api/v1/users/{uid} — admin updates profile fields.

users__routes__schemas__UserOut.title: UserOut
users__routes__schemas__UserOut.description: Safe user info returned to frontend. No password fields ever.
